question: Among SME customers who made transactions in Czech koruna (CZK) during the morning (before 13:00) of August 26, 2012, what percentage consumed more than 50.0 units in any single month?

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND t."XCL_011" = '2012-08-26'
      AND t."XCL_012" < '13:00:00'
),
customers_with_high_consumption AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT qc.customer_id
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON qc.customer_id = ym."XCL_019"
    WHERE ym."XCL_021" > 50.0
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT chc.customer_id) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id) AS percentage
FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
LEFT JOIN customers_with_high_consumption AS chc ON qc.customer_id = chc.customer_id

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS customer_id
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND t."XCL_011" = '2012-08-26'
      AND t."XCL_012" < '13:00:00'
),
customers_with_high_consumption AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT qc.customer_id
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON qc.customer_id = ym."XCL_019"
    WHERE ym."XCL_021" > 50.0
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT chc.customer_id) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id) AS percentage
FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
LEFT JOIN customers_with_high_consumption AS chc ON qc.customer_id = chc.customer_id

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS customer_id
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'SME'
      AND c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND t."XCL_011" = '2012-08-26'
      AND t."XCL_012" < '13:00:00'
),
customers_with_high_consumption AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT qc.customer_id
    FROM qualifying_customers qc
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON qc.customer_id = ym."XCL_019"
    WHERE ym."XCL_021" > 50.0
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT chc.customer_id) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT qc.customer_id) AS percentage
FROM qualifying_customers qc
LEFT JOIN customers_with_high_consumption chc ON qc.customer_id = chc.customer_id

WITH morning_czk_sme AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-26'
      AND t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
      AND c.XCL_002 = 'SME'
      AND (
          (t.XCL_014 < 13)
          OR (t.XCL_014 IS NULL AND t.XCL_015 < 13)
      )
),
monthly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013,
        t.XCL_015,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.XCL_013 IN (SELECT XCL_013 FROM morning_czk_sme)
    GROUP BY t.XCL_013, t.XCL_015
),
customers_with_high_month AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT XCL_013
    FROM monthly_consumption
    WHERE total_consumption > 50.0
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.XCL_013) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_013) AS percentage
FROM morning_czk_sme m
LEFT JOIN customers_with_high_month c ON m.XCL_013 = c.XCL_013
